scripts.start: node scripts/setup-data.ts && npm run build -w @tesseract/web && node apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.lan: node scripts/setup-data.ts && npm run build -w @tesseract/web && node apps/server/src/main.ts --lan
scripts.build:server: esbuild apps/server/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --splitting --outdir=apps/server/dist --entry-names=server --chunk-names=chunk-[hash] --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @tesseract/web && npm run build:server
scripts.desktop:install: node scripts/setup-data.ts && npm run build:desktop && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/desktop.ps1 install
